🗓 **TAWG Daily Catch-up**
_2026-10-06 23:00 → 2026-10-07 23:00 UTC_

## ⚡ **Highlights**

> **All 12 ERC-8004 vectors confirmed GREEN from cold clone** — An independent cold-clone run at commit d7a79dc showed both verifiers passing all 12 test vectors, completing the public verification loop. [Post #414](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/erc-8004-trustless-agents/25098/414)

> **Frozen bundle SHA-256 integrity independently confirmed** — The frozen bundle was run directly rather than from handoff text, producing an exact SHA-256 match with all internal checksums passing. [tg:tawg:5340]

> **PR #59 subject_bound fix verified from cold clone** — A fresh cold-clone re-read at commit a725f2e confirmed that subject_bound() now refuses before grading, pinning the expected CANNOT_ESTABLISH outcome. [tg:tawg:5337]

## 🤝 **What moved**

### ERC-8004

_Verification converged across multiple independent cold-clone runs, with the PR #59 fix, bundle integrity, and all 12 test vectors now confirmed._

- Baby Blue Viper **Clarified** that the serial-loop bug accounts for the ~10x committed-vs-plain performance gap as a mechanism rather than a measurement artifact, and identified the forward recompute (Layer-1) as the real performance lever — sharpening the group's shared model of what the numbers actually mean and where optimization effort should land. [tg:tawg:5334]

- Zexo (@zexoverz) **Confirmed** from a cold clone at commit a725f2e that the PR #59 fix holds: subject_bound() now refuses before grading, c6 pins subject_bound_check=CANNOT_ESTABLISH with evidence_grade null, and the M9 invariant is satisfied — giving the group an independent check of the boundary fix. [tg:tawg:5337]

- Zexo (@zexoverz) **Surfaced** that issue #61 has an empty body because it was filed with --body instead of --body-file, meaning the file contents were never submitted — unblocking the group from acting on a specification that was silently dropped at filing time. [tg:tawg:5338]

- Pavlo (@pavlentyy82) **Extended** the M9 invariant interpretation from a single witnessed refusal path to the full verdict-wide scope, clarifying that the refusal boundary is not branch-local — strengthening the group's confidence in the breadth of the correctness guarantee. [tg:tawg:5339]

- Pavlo (@pavlentyy82) **Verified** the frozen bundle directly and confirmed the exact SHA-256 hash with all internal checksums passing — providing tamper-evidence for the shared artifact and a stronger integrity baseline for the group. [tg:tawg:5340]

- Pavlo (@pavlentyy82) **Resolved** the resolution_reason interpretive question by aligning all three normative states against actual vector outputs, clarifying that it is a human-readable explanatory field rather than a machine-readable projection of the state enum — removing an ambiguity that could have caused downstream misalignment. [tg:tawg:5341]

- Baby Blue Viper **Published** confirmation to the ERC-8004 Ethereum Magicians thread that both verifiers are GREEN on all 12 vectors from a cold clone at d7a79dc, advancing the public record of the verification milestone for the broader ERC stakeholder community. [Post #414](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/erc-8004-trustless-agents/25098/414)

### WHIR

_Exploration of computation overhead alternatives for the PoW approach got underway._

- Jimmy Shi (@jimmyshi) **Opened** an investigation into whether alternative solutions on WHIR could reduce the computation overhead compared to the current PoW-based estimation, broadening the group's options for addressing a known performance concern before it becomes a bottleneck. [tg:tawg:5344]

## 🚀 **Next up**

### 💡 **Ideas to follow**

- Whether Layer-1 forward recompute optimization can quantifiably close the committed-vs-plain gap beyond what the serial-loop fix achieves
- How the verdict-wide refusal invariant holds across edge cases not yet covered by the current test vectors
- What WHIR-based alternatives exist and how their computation overhead compares to the PoW baseline

### ✅ **TODOs**

- Refile issue #61 using --body-file so the actual body content is submitted to the tracker
- Continue the WHIR computation overhead investigation and share findings with the group

## 🤖 **Trusty's take**

> **Today's spark:** A cold-clone verification relay completed end-to-end — the PR #59 fix was confirmed independently on Telegram, the frozen bundle's SHA-256 matched exactly, and all 12 test vectors landed GREEN in the public forum, closing the loop with tamper-evident receipts at every step.
>
> When the whole chain checks out from a cold start, even the build server starts to feel a little warm. 🔥
